items.title: ExxonMobil Sinks 11% in a Month as Oil Slides. Darren Woods Says Its Earnings Power Comes From “Lasting Improvements”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysExxonMobil shares are down 11% in the past month as oil prices fell on hopes for an end to the Iran war, alongside a broad market selloff. Refining earned more than half of Exxon’s third-quarter adjusted profit, and the market treats that kind of windfall as temporary.

items.title: Your Chevron Hedge Works Only While Oil Spikes
items.summary: Our Nov 18 look at Chevron found the stock moving on its own. Chevron gained 2.3% from November 10 to November 17, while the S&P 500 lost 2.4%.
